item.title: France’s new model for relations with Africa
item.description: Khaled Abou Zahr Emmanuel Macron is France’s first president who did not live through or experience the country’s colonialist past. item.title: US ambassador accuses Poland parliament speaker of insulting Trump
item.description: WARSAW (AFP): The United States embassy will have “no further dealings” with the speaker of the Polish parliament after claims he insulted President Donald Trump, its ambassador said on Thursday. item.title: Cuba president says willing to talk to US, but ‘without pressure’
item.description: HAVANA (AFP): Cuba is prepared to hold dialogue with the United States but not under pressure, President Miguel Diaz-Canel insisted Thursday after months of threats from US President Donald Trump. “Cuba is willing to engage in dialogue with the United States, a dialogue on any topic… but without pressure or preconditions,” Diaz-Canel said in an […]

item.title: Iran, US prepare for Oman talks after deadly protest crackdown
item.description: PARIS (AFP): Iran and the United States were preparing for talks on Friday in Oman, with Washington looking to see if there is any prospect of diplomatic progress on the Iranian nuclear programme and other issues while refusing to rule out military action. item.title: Trump finalizes rule making it easier to fire 50,000 federal workers
item.description: WASHINGTON: The Trump administration on Thursday finalized a rule that gives it the power to more easily fire an estimated 50,000 federal workers who focus on policy, striking many civil service safeguards while also gutting their whistleblower protections. item.title: India captain says will travel for Pakistan clash despite boycott
item.description: MUMBAI (AFP): India captain Suryakumar Yadav said Thursday that his team would show up in Colombo for their T20 World Cup clash against Pakistan, despite their Group A opponents and arch-rivals boycotting the match. “We haven’t said no to playing them (Pakistan),” Yadav told reporters at Mumbai’s Wankhede stadium, where India will begin their campaign […]

item.description: COLOMBO (AFP): Sri Lanka’s cricket board on Thursday urged Pakistan to reconsider its decision to boycott their first-round encounter with arch-rival India in the T20 World Cup co-hosted by the island.
